ModMetaData.name: N.E.K.O RimWorld Bridge (Dev)
ModMetaData.author: N.E.K.O Team
ModMetaData.description: Read-only v3.2 development bridge between RimWorld and N.E.K.O. This source version provides native situation background, exact and scoped queries, spatial observations, and read-only checks of player-order conditions and current threats. World places, factions, quests, existing trader stock and research support consultation; resource sources, native trade quotes and loaded-caravan journey estimates support decisions. Version 3.2.0 identifies the current source; it does not mark a published or deployed build. It does not execute gameplay actions or automate the colony.
